concept_decisions: Concept central tongue useful but toe too tall/cliffy and repeated sharp terraces overstate shallow process. Build one dominant broad rounded tongue continuously merged into gently sloping soil mantle, maximum toe relief0.65m above neighbouring slope, secondary partial lobe subtle and offset. No separate turf slab, texture, scattered overlapping rocks or regular staircase; palette boundary subordinate to actual geometry.
